The equiatomic CoCrFeNi HEA was prepared by vacuum induction melting, producing 6 mm thick ingots with a purity exceeding 99.9%.
The ingots were homogenized in vacuum at 1100 °C for 24 h and followed by air cooling.
Then these ingots were subsequently processed into thin sheets of 1 mm thickness through multiple rolling passes, achieving an 83 % reduction in thickness.
